author: Ankit
problem: Read a lowercase string S and print it with every vowel (a, e, i, o, u) removed.
bug_description: Only removes a, e and o; i and u stay in.

comments.accurate: Removes every vowel from the input string
comments.wrong_behavior: Removes the open vowels a, e and o, keeping i and u
comments.wrong_location: Vowel removal verified; check that the trailing newline is stripped from the input
